snippet.title: Roots Devour - Sneak Peek Trailer - Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
Extend your roots, imbibe fresh blood, and embrace demise. A new god graced the inhabitants of the forest on that fateful day. Roots Devour is a management strategy game. Drink blood to sustain your existence and seize dominion over the mysterious forest for greater power. Demo available now.
